title: Musa beer on TikTok
category: Social Media Strategy · Content Strategy · Creative Concept
intro: Developed during my postgraduate studies at IADE together with Sara, Vicente and Jorge, this group project explored how Portuguese craft beer brand MUSA could enter TikTok with a presence that felt unmistakably MUSA. The objective was to build brand awareness, engage a younger audience and create opportunities for community participation, without simply translating MUSA's existing social media presence onto another platform.

sections.heading: The Challenge
sections.text: MUSA already had a distinctive personality and strong presence across platforms such as Instagram and Facebook. TikTok, however, was largely unexplored territory. The challenge was not simply to make MUSA visible on TikTok, but to understand what the brand could contribute to the platform: how could its irreverent personality, connection to music and culture, and existing community translate into content people would actually want to watch and participate in?

sections.heading: My role
sections.text: My contribution focused on research, strategy and creative development. I worked on audience and competitor analysis, TikTok trends and positioning, and helped shape the content pillars and overall campaign structure. From there, I contributed to developing recurring content formats, seasonal activations, influencer ideas, hashtag challenges and community-led concepts designed to turn MUSA's audience from viewers into participants.

sections.heading: The Strategy
sections.text:
Our research pointed towards an audience that was urban, creative, culturally engaged and drawn to brands that felt authentic rather than overly polished. Instead of treating TikTok as another advertising channel, we approached it as an extension of MUSA's world, a place where beer could become the starting point for conversations around music, food, creativity and everyday culture.

Three themes became the foundation of the strategy: food, music and freestyle

items.title: Food
items.text: Recipes, pairings, chefs and food culture bringing MUSA into the moments where people eat, share and discover.

items.title: Music
items.text: Live sessions, playlists, festivals and emerging artists, reinforcing the connection between MUSA and music culture.

items.title: Freestyle
items.text: Art, humour, spontaneous formats and community creativity the space where the brand could experiment most freely.
